name: dropout
note: THE OPERATING POINT, which precedes every architecture question. Measured [here]: a trunk feature passes TWO Dropout1d(p=0.5) in series -- encoder_one.2 and encoder.dropout -- giving net trunk keep (1-p)^2 = 0.25, and 0.1875 including the 0.25 head dropout. `grep '"dropout"' sweeps/*.json` returns nothing, so EVERY arm ever run in this repo trains at that setting, including the -2.19 vs EEGNet. EEGNet's own reference is 0.25 applied ONCE, i.e. net keep 0.75 -- four times more signal reaching the head. Two sweeps downstream are unreadable until this is settled: `spatial` asks a CAPACITY question ('does an over-complete unconstrained mixer overfit subjects?') which cannot be answered while the model is simultaneously regularised to 10x that noise level, and `fairness` would defend our champion at p=0.5 against EEGNet at its author's setting, which is asymmetric by construction. ENDPOINTS ONLY, deliberately: p in {0.5, 0.0} maps to net trunk keep {0.25, 1.0}, and if those two do not separate by more than the noise floor then the interior is not worth buying. PRE-REGISTERED SELECTION RULE: this cell has val_frac=0.0, so there is NO validation set and taking the argmax of a curve would be selection on test against 4.73 [prior] measured points of pure selection noise. If the endpoints separate, the pick is the external convention -- EEGNet-matched net keep 0.75, i.e. p = 1-sqrt(0.75) ~ 0.134 -- and the whole curve is reported as evidence rather than a winner. A PEAK AT 0.5 IS NOT A NULL: it would say the trunk needs 10x-noise regularisation to avoid memorising subjects, which is a capacity indictment and promotes `spatial` to first.

arms.name: p50
arms.prediction: the as-run setting every existing result uses; net trunk keep 0.25. The reference the other endpoint is paired against.

arms.name: p00
arms.prediction: +2 to +5 over p50. Direction is NOT guaranteed: 0.5 may be doing real cross-subject regularisation that it was not doing in the subject-dependent cell where the -10.6 [prior] was measured. Falsified if |delta| < 1.5 with fewer than 7/10 folds moving one way.

arms.name: p13
arms.prediction: net trunk keep 0.75, matching EEGNet's convention. Included now rather than later only because it is 10 jobs and makes the curve readable in one pass; it is NOT to be selected by argmax.
